verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the historic centre of Verona, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Due Torri Hotel is located in the historic centre of Verona, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short distance from Juliet's balcony, Piazza Bra and the Verona Arena.
verified_facts.excerpt: a short distance from Juliet’s balcony, Piazza Bra and the world-famous Verona Arena

verified_facts.text: Mozart stayed at the Due Torri Hotel in 1777, and the Mozart Deluxe Suite is dedicated to him.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mozart Deluxe Suite is dedicated to the great composer who stayed at the Due Torri Hotel in 1777

verified_facts.text: The Maria Callas Deluxe Suite is named in honour of the soprano Maria Callas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Maria Callas Deluxe Suite is one of the most famous and requested suites in the hotel, named in honour of the famous soprano

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in a 14th-century residence.
Bistrot al 2 is in the Sala dell'Aquila, designed personally by chef Gualtiero Marchesi.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is located in the Sala dell’Aquila, designed personally by Gualtiero Marchesi

verified_facts.text: Bistrot al 2 has a dedicated entrance and welcomes non-residents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thanks to a dedicated entrance, Bistrot al 2 is more open than ever to the city, also welcoming non-residents

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop Gourmet Grill Restaurant sits around 30 metres above the ground, a short distance from Saint Anastasia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three hundred square metres suspended around 30 metres from the ground, a short distance away from Saint Anastasia.

verified_facts.text: The panoramic terrace with grill restaurant is available in the warmer months.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the warmer months, the splendid Terrazza Panoramica con Grill Restaurant is also available

verified_facts.text: The breakfast room walls are adorned with frescoes depicting locations in Verona.
verified_facts.excerpt: the frescoes which adorn the walls: images preserved in time, capable of skilfully recounting some of the most beautiful and iconic locations in Verona

verified_facts.text: The Due Torri Bar is on the piano nobile, with frescoes on its walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the piano nobile, the bar hosts guests in a refined and relaxing atmosphere, enhanced by the frescoes adorning the walls

verified_facts.text: Classic rooms are furnished in Empire style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Classic rooms, furnished in elegant Empire style

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe rooms are furnished with original period furniture.

verified_facts.text: The S. Anastasia Presidential Suite looks over Piazza Sant'Anastasia.
verified_facts.excerpt: The S. Anastasia Presidential Suite, looking over the square of the same name

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: We at the Hotel Due Torri, as members of The Leading Hotels of the World

verified_facts.text: The Backstage Vip Pass experience visits the theatre's backstage and technical areas to meet stagehands, tailors and property staff.
